name: Swamp
descriptions: Black water pools between hummocks of reeds and sedge. Each step sinks into mud that sucks at your boots.
Twisted trees rise from the murk, their roots arching above the water like grasping fingers.
A blanket of green scum covers still water. Bubbles rise slowly and burst with a foul smell.
Tall reeds close in on all sides, rattling softly in the wind. Frogs fall silent as you approach.
Clouds of midges swarm over a stretch of soggy ground. The air is thick, warm and wet.
A rotting boardwalk, long abandoned, sags into the bog here. Only a few planks remain above the water.
Grey mist curls low across the marsh, hiding the ground and muffling every sound.

lines: Something splashes in the water nearby.
The croaking of frogs rises and falls.
